# CI & Tooling Requirements Quality Checklist: Code Quality Tooling and Continuous Integration

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements in spec.md for tooling, formatting, and the CI gate are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the categories of issues static analysis must flag ("style and likely correctness") defined concretely enough to judge completeness, rather than left generic? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the "single agreed style" for formatting defined or referenced with concrete criteria, or only named abstractly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the exact set of paths to exclude (generated files, dependencies, build outputs) enumerated at the requirement level? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are both the current leftover project name and the intended replacement name specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec enumerate which quality commands must appear in documentation (analysis, formatting, type-check, tests, pipeline)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the initial repository-wide formatting normalization pass, or is it only captured as an assumption? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK007 Is "MUST NOT alter the runtime behavior of the application" paired with an objective way to verify it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "0 formatting drift after an initial normalization pass" clear about what constitutes drift? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the 10-minute pipeline target anchored to a defined runner/environment baseline so it is measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Are "supported developer operating systems" enumerated so FR-011 can be objectively evaluated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "clearly identify which step failed" defined with what constitutes clear step-level reporting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are the pipeline trigger requirements consistent across the Clarifications, FR-005, and FR-006a (PRs + pushes to `main` + branch protection)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications/§FR-005/§FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK013 Do "exit non-zero on any violation" (FR-002) and the "meaningful yet achievable" intent avoid conflicting on whether pre-existing violations block the initial baseline? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined that distinguish a check *failing* from a required check being *unable to run* (infra error)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements specified for how branch-protection enforcement is owned/verified given it is repository configuration external to the codebase? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for excluding generated UI primitives from lint noise while still formatting them? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the assumption that ESLint/Prettier/GitHub Actions are the chosen tools flagged as not affecting any technology-agnostic testable requirement? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the reused commands (existing type-check and test) documented as dependencies the pipeline relies on? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
